_comment: Synthetic Call #2 result for client report v3 layout verification. Type 9 / SX9, matching the reference implementation's client (Anders Wennerstrom). Contains NO authored report content: every AI-authored zone the client model can read (client_facing.*, client_words.*, coach_report.*) is optional and left empty, because the v3 Wings page is entirely library-driven. Only confirmed_type, alternate_candidate and dominant_instinct_hypothesis are strictly required by buildClientModel; the score vectors are included for the Quick Reference page in a later PR. Instinct values are the coach report's SX9 figures (SP 66 / SO 64 / SX 84) per design spec v3.0 section 4.3, which requires anything sourced from the mockup to be verified against the coach report.
